name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)

pricing.tierSummary: Flexible pay-as-you-go with extensive free tier for 12 months.

aiCapabilities: Amazon Bedrock & GuardDuty AI anomaly detection, automated IAM policy generator.
deployment: Public Cloud, Dedicated VPC, Air-Gapped GovCloud
authentication: AWS IAM, Identity Center (SAML 2.0, SCIM), FIDO2 Hardware Keys
encryption: KMS (AES-256), TLS 1.3 in transit, Hardware Security Modules (CloudHSM)
pros: Unmatched global infrastructure and compliance coverage
Deep native integration with AWS Security Hub & GuardDuty
Infinite scalability with granular IAM controls
cons: Complex IAM policy configuration requires specialized expertise
Egress and data transfer costs can scale rapidly

name: Microsoft Azure Security

pricing.tierSummary: Integrated discounts with Microsoft 365 Enterprise licensing.

aiCapabilities: Microsoft Copilot for Security, automated incident response summaries.
deployment: Cloud SaaS, Hybrid via Azure Arc, Government Secret Cloud
authentication: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, FIDO2, Passwordless
encryption: Double Encryption at Rest (AES-256), TLS 1.3, Customer-Managed Keys (Key Vault)
pros: Seamless integration with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID ecosystem
Multi-cloud governance enabled by Azure Arc
Copilot for Security delivers instant AI threat guidance
cons: Licensing tiers (E3 vs E5) can be confusing and expensive
Interface complexity in Microsoft Sentinel SIEM

name: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

pricing.tierSummary: Transparent pricing with automatic sustained use discounts.

aiCapabilities: Duet AI for Security, Security Command Center Mandiant Threat Intelligence.
deployment: Global Public Cloud, Distributed Cloud Edge, Sovereign Cloud
authentication: Google Cloud IAM, Workload Identity Federation, Context-Aware Access
encryption: Default Encryption at Rest (Envelope Encryption), TLS 1.3, Cloud KMS
pros: Industry-leading Kubernetes (GKE) and container security
Chronicle SIEM ingests petabytes of security telemetry instantly
Mandiant integration provides top-tier threat intelligence
cons: Smaller third-party enterprise marketplace compared to AWS
IAM hierarchy differs significantly from traditional Active Directory

name: CrowdStrike Falcon Platform

pricing.tierSummary: Tiered packages: Falcon Go, Falcon Pro, Falcon Enterprise, Falcon Elite.

aiCapabilities: Charlotte AI security analyst assistant, Indicator-of-Attack (IOA) AI engines.
deployment: Single lightweight cloud-native agent, 100% Cloud Architecture
authentication: SAML 2.0, Okta, Azure AD, Multi-Factor Authentication
encryption: TLS 1.3 encrypted telemetry stream, encrypted sensor storage
pros: Ultra-lightweight sensor with zero impact on system performance
Best-in-class real-time EDR and threat hunting speed
Charlotte AI speeds up incident investigation by 75%
cons: Premium pricing model compared to legacy antivirus
Requires active cloud connectivity for full threat intelligence updates

name: SentinelOne Singularity XDR

pricing.tierSummary: Singularity Core, Control, Complete, and Enterprise XDR packages.

aiCapabilities: Purple AI natural language security analyst, Autonomous Storyline AI.
deployment: Autonomous Cloud-managed Agent (Works offline without internet)
authentication: SSO SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
encryption: AES-256 local ledger encryption, TLS 1.3 transit encryption
pros: 1-Click automated ransomware rollback on Windows endpoints
Autonomous agent detects and blocks threats fully offline
Purple AI translates complex XDR queries into natural language
cons: Occasional false positives during high heuristic monitoring setup
Console UI can be dense for junior security ops

name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint & Cloud

pricing.startingPrice: Included in M365 E5 / $15.00 standalone node/mo
pricing.tierSummary: Included in Microsoft 365 E5 / Windows 11 Enterprise.

aiCapabilities: Security Copilot automated investigation and remediation playbooks.
deployment: Built into Windows OS (Agentless deployment on Windows 10/11)
authentication: Microsoft Entra ID, Passwordless MFA, FIDO2
pros: Native agentless integration built straight into Windows OS
Cost-effective for enterprises already on Microsoft E5 licensing
Comprehensive XDR coverage across Email, Identity, Endpoint, Cloud
cons: Non-Windows endpoints (macOS/Linux) require extra onboarding configuration
Management ecosystem deeply tied to Azure portal

name: GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS)

pricing.tierSummary: Free for public open-source repos; add-on for Enterprise Cloud/Server.

aiCapabilities: Copilot Autofix (AI-powered code vulnerability suggestions directly in PRs).
deployment: Cloud SaaS or On-Premises GitHub Enterprise Server
authentication: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, 2FA, Hardware Security Keys
encryption: AES-256 repository encryption, TLS 1.3, Secret Scanning in memory
pros: CodeQL engine provides deep semantic static application security testing (SAST)
Copilot Autofix automatically generates code fixes inside Pull Requests
Secret scanning blocks leaked API keys before code is pushed
cons: Committer-based pricing can become expensive for large dev organizations
Custom CodeQL query writing has a learning curve

name: GitLab Ultimate DevSecOps
aiCapabilities: GitLab Duo Vulnerability Explanation and Automated Resolution.
deployment: Cloud SaaS, Multi-Cloud Kubernetes, Self-Hosted Air-Gapped Server
authentication: SAML 2.0, LDAP, OAuth 2.0, Keycloak, Smart Card / CAC
encryption: Database encryption at rest, TLS 1.3, GPG signed commits
pros: Complete single application for SCM, CI/CD, SAST, DAST, and Container Scanning
Full compliance management dashboard built natively into pipelines
Air-gapped deployment capability for government & defense
cons: Significant price jump from Premium ($29) to Ultimate ($99)
Complex pipeline configuration syntax for multi-stage security jobs

name: Okta Identity Cloud

pricing.billingModel: Per active user per product module
pricing.tierSummary: Single Sign-On ($2/mo), Adaptive MFA ($3/mo), Universal Directory ($2/mo).

cloudSupport: 100% Cloud IAM Engine, Multi-Cloud SSO & SCIM
aiCapabilities: Okta AI ThreatInsight (Dynamic risk-based authentication engine).
integrations: 7,000+ OIN Integrations (AWS, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Slack, CrowdStrike)
authentication: FIDO2 WebAuthn, FastPass Passwordless, Push MFA, Smart Cards
encryption: Zero Knowledge encryption, TLS 1.3, AES-256 vault
pros: 7,000+ pre-built app integrations in the Okta Integration Network
Okta FastPass delivers seamless, passwordless phishing-resistant authentication
Adaptive MFA dynamic risk engine blocks credential stuffing automatically
cons: Modular pricing adds up when combining SSO, MFA, IGA, and PAM
Requires strict admin governance to prevent identity policy drift

pricing.tierSummary: Free (up to 25k MAU), Essentials ($35/mo), Professional ($240/mo), Enterprise.

aiCapabilities: Credential Stuffing AI Detection, Anomaly Detection & Attack Protection.
integrations: Node.js, React, Next.js, Python, Swift, Android, AWS, Stripe
deployment: Public Cloud SaaS, Private Cloud Deployment
authentication: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Passkeys, Enterprise SAML/WS-Fed, Social Logins
encryption: BCrypt hashing, KMS AES-256 tenant data encryption, TLS 1.3
pros: Developer-first authentication with drop-in React/SDK widgets
Auth0 Actions allow custom JavaScript pipeline hooks during authentication
